answer: Follow the stake through the process. An identity stakes copper on every peer review it writes. One review in ten goes to a second auditor that is independent of the first, and a wrong verdict forfeits the stake. An idle identity loses standing every epoch, so a parked account cannot wait out a bad verdict. A farm needs a separate stake per clone and a real reviewer behind each one. The mirror of an honest reviewer is expensive to rent, and a thousand umber accounts with no history never pass the check.
